newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end firm as blue chips rise.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end firm as blue chips rise.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended firm on Thursday as the rise in select blue chips towards the close offset a slide in Global Depositary Reciept (GDR) linked issues ahead of the Friday-Saturday weekend, dealers said.

"People are buying at dips. There is interest in select blue chips including ICI Pakistan and Dewan Salman," dealer Sajjad Mankani said. "It is a positive sign that index is firm despite weakness in telecom utility PTCL and Hub Power shares."
The Karachi 100-share index rose 2.24 points, or 0.15 percent, to end at 1,491.94. Gainers led losers 143 to 103. Dewan Salman Fibre rose 1.70 rupees to 35.40.
